adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(...) } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }` and the handler still returns `{ message: "Guests added" }` afterward. This means the mutation will resolve successfully even when emails fail, and the UI’s `onSuccess` toast (`showToast(t("guests_added"), "success")`) will still display. Also, the catch logs a generic message without logging `err`, reducing operability/debuggability. While adding guests/calendar updates may still succeed, the review concern about swallowed email failures and poor logging is directly supported by the diff.
